SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT SEQ FROM EPRO_MRO.DBO.SAMYANGGROUP_RFQ_IF_R WHERE SEND_YN = 'N'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'SYGP' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, CENTER_CD AS PLANT, ISNULL(EST_REQ_DT,' ') AS QUOTATION_NO, ISNULL(ITM_NO,' ') AS QUOTATION_SEQ, '1' AS REVISION, 'C' AS STATUS, SUBSTRING(EST_REQ_DT,1,8) AS ADD_DATE, SUBSTRING(EST_REQ_DT,9,6) AS ADD_TIME, ISNULL(ITM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, ISNULL(ITM_NM,' ') AS DESCRIPTION, ISNULL(SPEC,' ') AS SPECIFICATION, ISNULL(UOM,' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE, ISNULL(MAKER,' ') AS MAKER_NAME, ISNULL(ORIGIN,' ') AS ORIGIN_NAME, ISNULL(SUB_SUPP_NM,' ') +'/'+ ISNULL(PRE_ENTER_SUP_NM,' ') + '/' + ISNULL(REAL_SUPPLY_DT,' ') AS OLD_AGENT, CONVERT(FLOAT,ISNULL(TARGET_EST_PRICE,0)) AS PREV_UNIT_PRICE, ISNULL(REQ_EMP_NO,' ') AS ADD_USER_ID, ISNULL(REQ_EMP_NM,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, ' ' AS REQ_USER_DEPT, ISNULL(REQ_EMP_TEL,' ') AS REQ_USER_TEL, ISNULL(REQ_EMP_EMAIL,' ') AS REQ_USER_MAIL, ' ' AS CLOSE_DATE, CONVERT(varchar,SY_SEQ)+'^'+ISNULL(REQ_ID,'')+'^'+ISNULL(CONT_ID,'')+'^'+CONVERT(varchar,SEQ) +'^'+ ISNULL(ERP_RFX_NO,'') AS REF_IF_NO, '190000' AS CLOSE_TIME, CONVERT(FLOAT,ISNULL(EST_QTY,0)) AS ITEM_QTY, ISNULL(REQ_COMMENT,' ') AS REMARK, ISNULL(REG_DT,' ') AS REG_DATE, ISNULL(ERP_RFX_NO,' ') AS ETC_REMARK, ISNULL(RFX_RECEIVE_REQ_DT,' ') AS RD_DATE, ISNULL(PRE_ENTER_FG,' ') AS BUYER_PRE_GR_FLAG FROM EPRO_MRO.DBO.SAMYANGGROUP_RFQ_IF_R WHERE SEQ = '$G_RS.SEQ$'
UPDATE EPRO_MRO.DBO.SAMYANGGROUP_RFQ_IF_R SET SEND_YN = 'Y' , SEND_DT = GETDATE() WHERE SEQ = '$G_RS.SEQ$'
